activities.activity_description: Define the API signatures, input/output types, and overall design for the new configuration helper functions across U1-U7.
Develop the functions to add and remove an orderer endpoint to/from an orderer org's config group and compute the ConfigUpdate transaction.
Develop the function to retrieve existing policies for a specific organization (application, orderer, or consortium) without manual parsing.
Develop the function to retrieve existing orderer, application, and channel capabilities, returning a config.Capabilities object.
Develop toggle functions to add and remove application, orderer, and channel capabilities, modifying the config transaction safely.
Develop the function to retrieve existing application configuration, returning a config.Application object.
Develop the function to add or remove ACLs within an application group's configuration in a config transaction.
Refactor the existing giant end-to-end example test into smaller, varied examples covering orderer config, app values, org management, MSP modifications, and capabilities.
Write and execute unit and integration tests for all newly implemented functions to ensure they correctly modify and retrieve config data.
Update any necessary inline documentation, review code against Fabric contribution guidelines, and perform a final self-review.
